integrity: The proof and checker support the same stated classification and count; later-variant literature is used only for comparison and not as evidence of independence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the standard comb P_n corona K_1 and minimum ordinary zero forcing sets.
The scalar zero forcing number is prior via the tree path-cover theorem and is not claimed as new.
Finite exhaustive checks through n=11 support but do not replace the general proof.
Literature search cannot exclude an obscure unindexed equivalent enumeration.
title: Minimum zero forcing sets of standard comb graphs
